label_convention.CAD_EXTRACTED: Read directly from the Onshape B-rep or feature list; only unit conversion (m -> mm) or radius -> diameter applied.
label_convention.GEOMETRICALLY_INFERRED: Computed by apsd_cam from CAD values (projections, spans, distances, section loops, feature types, patterns). Deterministic and re-runnable, but an interpretation.
label_convention.HUMAN_ANNOTATED: Supplied by a named team member with a cited source and date; never merged into the CAD values.
label_convention.UNKNOWN: Not available from the CAD data or a verified human source; value is null.

limitations: Lathe facts come from the Chapter 1 builder (vendored unchanged); its own limitations apply (see vendor_ch1/apsd_pipeline/manifest.py).
Thread regions are located with loose bounding boxes of helical faces; thread sizes are not derivable from this model.
No drawing annotation text is available through the Onshape API; drawing-only information enters only as HUMAN_ANNOTATED entries.
The CAD frame is not the machining frame: the lathe work zero and X-as-diameter convention are set in the shared experiment configuration.
